entries.name: Epic Crossbow Doctrine V

entries.text: +140 all AP, +60 poison DMG, stacks up to 2x. Mandatory per Amya.

entries.text: +23% rate of fire. Mandatory per Amya.

entries.text: +40% shooting accuracy, +80 piercing DMG. OP notes "likely same doctrine as 'Accuracy Doctrine' on Demesne Arbalists." Mandatory per Amya.

doctrines.note: Veterancy: Poison Line. Hero pairing: not specified in this thread. OP verbatim note: "Replace Double Fire by Double Shot (Epic Crossbow V) -- both unlock double-bolt mechanic but Double Shot has longer-CD/shorter-duration vs Double Fire's 45s CD / +12% ROF baseline. Amya's pick: Double Shot." 'Top Pick' bracket is entirely absent from this OP's Doctrines structure (goes straight from Mandatory to Filler) -- not a capture omission, that's how the OP is structured. Build guide video linked by OP (not transcribed, external link out of scope): 'How to use Rattan Marskmen correct | Conquerors blade Tutorial' (YouTube, channel Grk) -- doctrines shown at 0:30s, veterancy = Poison Line, per OP's own description. No dedicated Tips & Tricks text section (guidance deferred to the linked video). 'Don't put' is a literal X placeholder in the OP. Edit timestamp (2026-05-27) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; Rattan Marksmen is NOT on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so staleAsOfPatch is not forced — noting pre-patch authorship per instructions only. Note: distinct unit from Rattan Pikemen / Rattan Roundshields / Rattan Vipers -- confirmed separate slug, separate guide thread, separate tierlist entry.
